cycle.name: New 6-week cycle
focus: Past the midpoint — now we use the foundation
Power snatch doubles + strict handstand push-ups
Cluster squats 2-1-1-1, snatch-grip deadlifts, pulling practice continue
Monday intervals · Tuesday efficiency · Friday 9 rounds of thrusters / T2B / row
cycle.full_text:
HAPPY SUNDAY, CFNYC ☀️

First things first: we hope everyone made it through this very dramatic little nor'easter safe, dry, and with all outdoor furniture still accounted for. Nothing says welcome to fall in New York quite like going from beautiful September weather to sideways rain and wind that makes walking down the street feel suspiciously like a conditioning piece. Fortunately, we know a nice dry place where you can spend the week.

We're officially heading into Week 4 of 6, which means we've crossed that lovely little midpoint where the movements are familiar, the foundation has been laid, and now we get to actually use it. CrossFit keeps building on the work we've been doing—power snatches, cluster squats, pulling skills, unilateral strength—with some very fun conditioning sprinkled in. Monday gives us intervals (and therefore permission to actually attack the work), Tuesday rewards efficiency, and Friday has nine rounds of heavy-ish thrusters, toes-to-bar and rowing, which feels like an extremely normal way to welcome October. HYROX is putting in the grunt work this week with longer race-style efforts and plenty of opportunities to practice working hard, recovering, and doing it again. ATHX has everything from pause squats and Tabatas to a partner Echo Bike situation that may test both your fitness and your friendships. Strength is back under heavy triples, and Oly is cleaning, jerking, pausing, and generally getting very comfortable putting heavy things overhead. And that's Week 4: we're not learning the dance anymore. Now we get to dance a little harder. Come train. Keep stacking good reps. Maybe enjoy being indoors for a minute. New week. New month incoming. Let's get after it, CFNYC.

announcements.title: Halloween Throwdown — Sat, Oct 31, 11:15 AM (UWS)
announcements.detail: In-house partner competition, open to all members: teams of two (women's, men's, mixed), prescribed weights per division, Best Costume award. Registration details coming.
announcements.full_text:
🎃 CFNYC HALLOWEEN THROWDOWN: IT'S OFFICIAL!

Remember when we said putting this in the newsletter made it legally binding? Well, we have a date, a time, and a location. There's no backing out now.

SAVE THE DATE and open to ALL MEMBERS!!!

SATURDAY, OCTOBER 31 👻

11:15 AM · CFNYC Upper West Side

In-House Partner CrossFit Competition

Yes, we know it's Halloween weekend. All the more reason to dress up, work out, and have a ridiculously fun morning with your gym friends before heading out to haunt the town, take the kids trick-or-treating, or make some questionable decisions at a Halloween party later that night.

Here's the plan: grab a partner and compete as a women's, men's, or mixed team of two. Each workout will have prescribed weights and standards for each division, so start finding the person whose particular brand of fitness complements yours.

And, obviously, costumes are highly encouraged.

There will be workouts. There will be prizes. There will be bragging rights. And there will absolutely be a Best Costume award, because athletic performance matters, but so does committing aggressively to a theme.

Come compete. Come cheer. Come hang out. Whether you're trying to win the whole thing or simply trying to convince your partner that your two-person costume concept is worth doing burpees in, we want you there.

So mark your calendar, find your partner, and start plotting your costumes. Registration details, workouts, and all the other good stuff are coming soon.

Halloween morning: we throw down. Halloween night: we haunt the town.

Fill out the interest form via the link in the newsletter.

announcements.title: ATHX New York — Sat, Aug 28, 2027
announcements.detail: ATHX's 2027 calendar puts a hometown race in New York, and ATHX has announced a partnership with CrossFit. Also Miami, Chicago, Las Vegas and more.
announcements.full_text:
⚡️ ATHX X CROSSFIT: 2027, WE SEE YOU

Big news for our ATHX crew: ATHX has announced its 2027 event calendar, and NEW YORK IS ON IT. 🗽

SAVE THE DATE

SATURDAY, AUGUST 28, 2027

ATHX New York

As listed on the newly announced 2027 event calendar.

If you've been coming to ATHX at CFNYC, consider this your very early heads-up: you have a hometown race to train for. And if you've been ATHX-curious, there's plenty of time to come see what all the fuss is about.

And the timing couldn't be better: ATHX has also announced a partnership with CrossFit, bringing two worlds our community already loves a little closer together.

As a CFNYC ATHX affiliate, we're here to help you prepare for the whole challenge: strength, endurance, and MetCon. Not just getting through each part individually, but learning how to put them together when it counts.

Whether you're eyeing your first ATHX or already planning your next one, come train with us. You don't need to have a race booked to start building the fitness for it—and you certainly don't need to wait until August.

The newly announced North American calendar also includes Miami, Chicago, Las Vegas, and more, so there are plenty of opportunities to make a race weekend out of it.

New York, we have a date. CFNYC, we have a training plan. Let's get a crew together and make some noise.

announcements.title: Community: Dads With Pride playdate — Sun, Oct 4, 12–2 PM
announcements.detail: New NYC community for gay dads, their kids, and anyone who wants to support them. Matthew Sapolin Playground, 270 W 70th St. Drop in anytime; RSVP if you're coming.
announcements.full_text:
COMMUNITY CORNER: DADS WITH PRIDE

We love when members of our community are building community outside the gym, too—so we wanted to share this very sweet one.

Dads With Pride is a new NYC community for gay dads, their kids, those considering fatherhood, and anyone who wants to support them.

Once a month, they take over a Manhattan playground for a good old-fashioned playdate: kids get to be kids while dads meet other dads, swap stories and advice, and build a little more community along the way.

The dads bring the kids and conversation. Dads With Pride brings the coffee and donuts. Frankly, an excellent division of labor.

Their next meetup is:

Sunday, October 4 | 12–2 PM
Matthew Sapolin Playground
270 W 70th St, between Amsterdam & West End
Drop in anytime!

If this sounds like something for you—or someone you know—come hang out, meet some new people, and help a new NYC community grow.

Please RSVP if you're planning to join. You can also follow @dads.with.pride on Instagram or sign up for emails about future meetups via the link in the newsletter.
